notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
🎉 Big Launch Event for Loot Box! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Loot Box on Steam! To celebrate, we're hosting a special in-game event filled with exciting rewards, exclusive content, and lots of fun activities. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the world of loot collecting, this event is your chance to dive in, collect unique loot, and be part of our growing community.

Event Highlights:

🛡️ Special Loot Drops: Participate in the event to receive exclusive loot boxes, on a shorter duration.
